verdict.rationale: The CLI ships `skills init [name]`, which creates a new SKILL.md template, so authoring has a scaffolding tool. An install example names a `skill-creator` skill in vercel-labs/agent-skills, which hints at a meta-skill, but nothing describes what it does. The spec also references `skills-ref validate` for checking a skill. Missing for 10: evidence that skill-creator actually guides an agent through writing and improving skills, an agent-guided iteration or improvement workflow, packaging/publishing guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
